title: Input schema of the Instagram Reels Music Trends

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Reels feeds, hashtag pages, or profile pages to start scraping (public or authenticated).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made by this crawler per run.

authMethod.title: Authentication method
authMethod.description: Set to 'cookie' to provide a cookie string, 'credentials' for username/password login, or 'none' for unauthenticated scraping (limited).

cookieString.title: Cookie string
cookieString.description: If authMethod is 'cookie', paste your Instagram session cookie here (keep secret, use env vars on Cloud).

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for credentials-based login (if authMethod is 'credentials').

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for credentials-based login (if authMethod is 'credentials').

dedupe.title: Deduplicate audio clips
dedupe.description: If true, the Actor stores seen audio IDs in Key-Value store and only outputs newly discovered clips.
